english.title: Fail to send UKRI test details of water flow before work sinking well or borehole was completed or abandoned
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person sinking a well or borehole intended to reach a depth of more than fifty feet below the surface, failed to send to the United Kingdom Research and Innovation particulars of a test made on **(..SPECIFY DATE OF TEST..) before completion or abandonment of the work of the flow of water
english.legislation: Contrary to section 198(2)(b) and (8) of the Water Resources Act 1991.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location

english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, being a person sinking a well or borehole intended to reach a depth of more than fifty feet below the surface, failed to send to the United Kingdom Research and Innovation particulars of a test made on **(..SPECIFY DATE OF TEST..) before completion or abandonment of the work of the flow of water.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale and, where the offence continues after conviction, to a further fine of £20 for every day during which it so continues

Time Limit for Prosecutions:
6 months
